name: Silver Moon
source:
Our protagonist grows up in Geo, a facility that gives special education for gifted children.
He rejects life as an elite and instead lives a normal college life.

Suddenly, he's confronted with a woman called V.A. who informs him about his abnormal physical condition and declares he has 15 days left to live.

The four girls surrounding him, the secret of "Geo", and the intentions of the mysterious V.A... How will he survive the remaining 15 days of his life?

[Translated from the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ001164.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主人公在为天赋儿童提供特殊教育的设施“Geo”中长大。
他拒绝了精英生活，转而过着普通的大学生活。

突然，自称V.A.的女性找上门，告知他身体状况异常，并宣布他只剩15天可活。

身边的四名少女、“Geo”的秘密，以及神秘V.A.的意图……他要如何在生命剩余的15天里活下去？
